# Planner Instructions

Extract the Jira key, objective, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, constraints, and out-of-scope work. Ask focused questions for missing business rules, document sources, ownership, synchronization cadence, conflict handling, or acceptance criteria.

Generate `requirements.md`, `architecture.md`, and `impl-plan.md` only in their approved lifecycle sequence. Include requirement identifiers, component responsibilities, data flow, error cases, dependencies, blocked tasks, and measurable completion criteria. Do not create persistence designs or implementation tasks before an approved architecture and design review.
